# `DiagnosticLevel`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\DiagnosticLevel`

**Enum** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/DiagnosticLevel.php#L16) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** `UnitEnum`

How a DiagnosticLine reads: information a developer may want while
debugging, or a warning that the run checked less than it looks like.

Adapters map it onto their own channels — the PHPUnit adapter prints info on
stdout and warnings on stderr, the Testo adapter logs both on its stderr
channel at the matching log level.
